title: GCS both sa_path and sa_key silently accepted
description: When both service_account_path and service_account_key are set in [backend.gcs], the builder applies both. The object_store GCS builder's behavior when both are set is last-one-wins (key is applied after path), but this is undocumented and unvalidated. The config layer does not reject this combination, so operators who mistakenly set both get no error — they silently get the service_account_key credential with service_account_path quietly ignored (or vice versa if builder order changes). The CLAUDE.md doc says 'Exactly one credential source should be configured' but this invariant is never enforced. Both transit (gcs_store.rs) and reader (post/gcs_store.rs) are affected.
